label: Anthropic assistance provider connector
summary: Prepare an optional Anthropic provider adapter for selected models and consented support or operational assistance.
core_boundary: Provider tool suggestions cannot invoke shell commands, container sockets, privileged daemons or unrestricted Core endpoints. This is a design-only connector proposal. Essential hosting, current actor and tenant authorization, native service drivers and recovery remain in the free Core. No production interface, publisher trust, installation or effectful capability is established by this metadata.
acceptance: Pin a reviewed interface and model policy with declared data handling, tenant isolation and request/output budgets.
Qualify hostile documents, tool-output injection and unsafe suggested actions without treating model confidence as authorization.
Maintain redacted local evidence and usable Core operation when the provider is disabled, rate-limited, unavailable or no longer entitled.

Before implementation, qualify an explicitly selected provider/interface revision, supported compatibility matrix, immutable package provenance, dependency inventory and licensing model; no release is admitted by this proposal.

Enforce current Core actor, tenant and capability checks at each admitted request; keep credentials in scoped secret references, redact diagnostics and reject arbitrary destinations, shell commands or host/container sockets.

Demonstrate that disablement, removal, provider outage and commercial entitlement loss preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, local audit and recovery; retain owned data unless a separately authorized purge is requested.
